description: This file contains a helper class for testing call chain reentrancy in Orleans grains, including multiple test scenarios and a reentrancy observer.

classes.name: CallChainReentrancyTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods to test various call chain reentrancy scenarios in Orleans grains, including suppression and observer mechanisms.

classes.name: CallChainObserver
classes.description: An observer class implementing ICallChainObserver to monitor call chain operations during tests.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_1
methods.description: Tests allowed reentrancy on a non-reentrant grain with a simple call chain.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_2
methods.description: Tests reentrancy on a sequence of non-reentrant grains.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_3
methods.description: Tests reentrancy involving a reentrant grain with a specific call pattern.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_4
methods.description: Tests a call chain with two reentrant grains, expecting no deadlock.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_5
methods.description: Tests a call chain with reentrant grains with specific blocking pattern.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_6
methods.description: Tests reentrancy on non-reentrant grains with a full chain pattern.

methods.name: CallChainReentrancy_WithSuppression
methods.description: Tests suppression of call chain reentrancy within a reentrant call chain.
